unresolved_current_source_conflicts: Betaine: document says ALLMAX; user reconfirmed NOW. NOW remains in V1/V6.
DMZ: document says lunch; user reconfirmed afternoon. Afternoon remains. Beef Liver/Ligament Restore meal placement is not silently transferred into the same DMZ group.
Medi-C Plus: document attributes 105 mg magnesium to a half scoop, conflicting with prior confirmed calcium-ascorbate package. Do not put those magnesium totals or derived daily totals into images.

S016 Endurance Pill appears as a rest-only formulation without identifiable brand/product or package; not generated as a retail item or integrated into the active pill grid. Its payload and rest-day schedule conflict with other source summaries.
Rest-day biotin table counts the multivitamin although the same document says it is skipped. Exact rest-day totals are unresolved.

Clinical cause/effect, rigid natural-muscle ceilings, hydration-attributed SMM increments and renal-test mandates are source claims, not independently established facts. Not included as verified illustration claims.
750 mg active creatine is the consumed dose, not package net weight.
